findings.governingReading: Rin burns incense as part of the diagnostic procedure.
findings.explanation: The mass noun is given a malformed singular article.

findings.governingReading: Rin says further discrimination or classification lies outside her specialty.
findings.explanation: “Consecration” invents a religious rite and makes the diagnostic explanation incoherent.

findings.highlight: meat that never goes away, no matter how much of it you eat
findings.evidenceJa: 中国に伝わる幾ら食べても減らない肉、だったっけか
findings.governingReading: Shirou tentatively recalls shiniku as inexhaustible meat handed down in Chinese tradition.
findings.explanation: The cultural provenance and his uncertain recollection both disappear.

findings.highlight: I do regret that you’re an amateur
findings.evidenceJa: 後悔はしてるけど……未熟って言っても
findings.governingReading: Rin admits regretting the alliance, then qualifies Shirou’s immaturity by locating the problem in how he was taught.
findings.explanation: The object of regret becomes his amateur status, collapsing her pivot away from inherent incompetence.

findings.governingReading: Rin asks about projected objects remaining in Shirou’s magus workshop.
findings.explanation: The mundane building replaces its magical function.

findings.highlight: I use projection as a breather in between strengthening magic
findings.evidenceJa: “強化”の息抜き、魔術が上手くいかない時の試しで行う“投影”
findings.governingReading: Shirou uses Projection both as a diversion from Reinforcement and as an experiment when magecraft is going badly.
findings.explanation: The second and diagnostically relevant circumstance disappears.

findings.highlight: She told me to make a vase
findings.governingReading: Rin assigns an earthenware teapot as the Projection target.
findings.explanation: The requested object changes to a vase.

findings.evidenceJa: もう夕暮れ時になっていた
findings.explanation: The concrete time and completed onset of evening become vague lateness.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka is helping me as a fellow magus
findings.evidenceJa: 戦友として、魔術師としての俺を面倒みてくれている
findings.governingReading: Rin cares for him as a comrade-in-arms and looks after his development as a magus.
findings.explanation: Two asymmetric relationships collapse into the false suggestion that Shirou and Rin are simply peer magi.

findings.evidenceJa: 家に残してきた桜も心配だ
findings.governingReading: Shirou also worries about Sakura whom he left behind at home.
findings.explanation: Her location and his responsibility for leaving her there disappear.
